year.label: 2019 Clubsport with the Manthey MR kit

records.real_world_identity_notes: Customer racing 718 Cayman with the Manthey Racing MR kit. Porsche drives the rear wheels through a dual-clutch PDK gearbox with six gears, and the MR kit revises aerodynamics and suspension without changing the powertrain. A PDK has no clutch pedal, so the real car cannot require clutch input to pull away, even though AMS2 does; that difference is recorded as an explicit simulator override rather than by asserting something false about the car.
records.confidence_basis: Simulator behavior was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the real-world transmission is established by a registered manufacturer source.
records.identity_basis: The registered manufacturer source establishes the real-world identity and transmission, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
records.specification_basis: Porsche specifies a six-speed dual-clutch PDK and Manthey confirms the MR kit leaves the powertrain unchanged; the live drive confirmed six paddle-selected gears.
control_notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled.
The real car is a six-speed PDK dual clutch and has no clutch pedal, so its standing-start clutch is recorded as not required.

AMS2 1.6.9.91 nonetheless required clutch input to move off. That is recorded as an explicit simulator override, so the in-sim guidance tells the driver to use the clutch while the record keeps the real car's value.
No throttle lift is required on upshifts and no manual blip on downshifts, because the drive detected automatic cut and automatic blip.
